links.outcome: Accuracy of fabrication detectors (macro F1) across evidence conditions, including expert clinicians
links.effect: Expert clinicians reached 53.3% macro F1 and no detector family cleared about 60% without gold evidence. A strong LLM scored 91% with gold evidence and 35% with wrong evidence.
links.quote: On MedFabric the task is unsolved: expert clinicians reach only 53.3% macro F1 and no detector family clears about 60% without gold evidence.

links.outcome: Expert clinicians' ability to detect word-level medical fabrications (macro F1)
links.effect: Expert clinicians reached only 53.3% macro F1 detecting fabrications, so unverified fluent but wrong LLM statements may not be caught.
links.quote: On MedFabric the task is unsolved: expert clinicians reach only 53.3% macro F1 and no detector family clears about 60% without gold evidence.

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-confidence gate that abstains on low-confidence evidence, raising macro F1 from 61% to 74%
Benchmark design that removes authorship-style shortcuts when evaluating fabrication detectors

screen.reason: The study develops and tests a benchmark for medical hallucination/fabrication detection and evaluates a specific safeguard/deployment practice (a retrieval-confidence gate that abstains on low-confidence evidence).
